title: TopoPerception: A Shortcut-Free Evaluation of Global Visual Perception in Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the prediction distributions and confusion matrices of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) on a multiple-choice Visual Question Answering (VQA) task to determine if the models default to intrinsic preferences for specific answer options (e.g., constantly selecting Option A or C) rather than relying on the visual input.

Evaluating how the structural inductive biases of visual encoders (such as processing fixed-size square images via resizing, padding, or patching) cause the loss of global visual features and topological properties at various perceptual granularities.
